items.q: What did AI assistants turn customers into?
items.a: An **approval queue**—humans as the agent API.

items.q: What question do payments ask that coding agents don't?
items.a: **Did this customer authorize this payment to this recipient on these terms?**

items.q: What must the customer agree to?
items.a: An **immutable job**—the whole job, not every step.

items.q: What are the two views of the job?
items.a: A **human-language promise** and a **machine-readable** bound services can enforce.

items.q: When can the agent re-plan freely?
items.a: When the new plan stays **inside the agreement**; changed terms need a **new customer decision**.

items.q: What happens if prompt injection 'updates' payment details?
items.a: It **fails at the service check**—the model cannot rewrite the agreement.
Customer **agrees to the job**, agent **chooses steps**, services **enforce**.
